certifiedResults.title: Michigan SOS official county result export
certifiedResults.detail: Presidential county totals are parsed from the official Michigan Voter Information Center election result export for the 2024 general election. The source is Cloudflare-protected, so the state builder downloads it through the browser-backed downloader.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Official MVIC export generated by scripted browser download; the endpoint does not expose a durable file Last-Modified timestamp.

wardDetail.title: Michigan SOS county rows for statewide contests
wardDetail.detail: The official export includes county rows for President and U.S. Senate. The app converts those county rows into the review graph schema for statewide President-vs-Senate comparison.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official MVIC export generated by scripted browser download; the endpoint does not expose a durable file Last-Modified timestamp.
